Index.title: Tickets
Index.intro: Event tickets — generic, multilingual, ready to grow through the implementation phases.

EventsList.headline: Upcoming events
EventsList.intro: Conscious events from Berlin and nearby. Book direct — tickets by email with QR code.

EventDetail.notFoundBody: This event doesn't exist or was withdrawn.
EventDetail.soldOutBody: You can still register — we'll put you on the waitlist and reach out as soon as a spot opens up.

BookingForm.testModeBannerBody: Bookings confirm instantly without real payment. Delete test bookings before going live.
BookingForm.paymentDonationBody: You register now — you contribute directly at the event. Your ticket is valid immediately.
BookingForm.paymentAtDoorBody: You pay at the venue. Your ticket is valid immediately — the QR code arrives by email.
BookingForm.paymentBeforehandHeadline: Pay by bank transfer or PayPal
BookingForm.paymentBeforehandBody: After booking you'll get an email with payment details. Once payment arrives we send the QR code for your ticket. Seats are reserved for 7 days.
BookingForm.paymentBeforehandPaypalTrailing: You'll be redirected to PayPal. After payment we send the QR code as soon as the money lands.
BookingForm.paymentBeforehandPaypalHint: PayPal link will appear here once the amount is calculated.

errors.donation_below_min: The amount is below the minimum contribution.
errors.donation_config_missing: Donation configuration is missing for this event.
errors.no_active_phase: No pricing phase is active right now.
errors.invalid_contact: Contact info incomplete — name and email are required.
errors.waitlist_available: Event is sold out — you'll land on the waitlist.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

Booked.testBody: This booking was a pipeline preview only. The confirmation email (prefixed [TEST]) is on its way.
Booked.testBanner: ⚠ TEST booking — no real payment was triggered.
Booked.donationBody: Your tickets are in the confirmation email. You contribute directly at the event.
Booked.paidBody: Your tickets are on the way — the confirmation email contains the QR code.
Booked.bookedBody: We got your booking. A confirmation email with all the details is on its way.
Booked.spamBody: We send the confirmation with tickets immediately. If it doesn't arrive within a few minutes, check your Spam folder (or "Promotions" / "Junk"). If you find it there: mark it as "Not spam" once — then all future emails from us will land in your inbox.

Waitlisted.banner: The event was sold out — you're on the waitlist.
Waitlisted.headline: You're on the waitlist
Waitlisted.explainPaid: As soon as a spot opens up, we'll reach out by email. You don't have to do anything — no cost until you get a seat.
Waitlisted.explainModes: For paid events you'll get a link to claim the spot within 24 hours — first click wins. For donation events you're promoted automatically and your tickets arrive instantly.
Waitlisted.removeHint: The remove-from-waitlist link is in the confirmation email we just sent you.

WaitlistClaim.claimedBody: Redirecting you to the booking confirmation…
WaitlistClaim.lostBanner: Too bad — someone else claimed it before you.
WaitlistClaim.lostBody: You stay on the waitlist — when another spot opens, you'll get a new link. We'll reach out automatically.
WaitlistClaim.invalidBody: This link is invalid or has expired. If you're on the waitlist, check your inbox for the current link.

WaitlistRemove.removedBody: We won't reach out again if spots open up. If you change your mind, you can re-register on the event page any time.
WaitlistRemove.fulfilledBody: A spot has been assigned to you — cancellation here doesn't apply. Reply to the booking confirmation if you want to release your spot.
WaitlistRemove.invalidBody: This link is invalid or has expired.

Setup.headline: Set up your account
Setup.intro: Pick a password to finish setting up your kreise.berlin admin account.
Setup.doneBanner: Account activated — redirecting you to sign in…
Setup.tooShort: Password must be at least 12 characters.
Setup.invalidToken: The setup link is invalid or expired. Ask an admin for a fresh invitation.
